messages.subject: Coordinates of CpG
parts:
Hi,

Is there a way that I can obtain the number of CpG of each tiles defined by methylkit, regardless of whether it is covered or not?
Can I clarify if CpG is defined as "CG" in the forward strand and "GC" in the reverse strand?
And also, methylkit read in coordinates in 0-based or 1-based?

Thank you.

Wilson

messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Coordinates of CpG
parts:
Hi,

I am answering part of your question.

  • Methylkit understands bed file (0 based) and reads it with read.bed() function. Converts it into 1 based GRanges object
  • Every other methylKit object is 1 based.
  • To my understanding, methylKit defines CpG on strand basis. For this reason, the methylKit input file has F/R strand notation. One can combine the strand information using 'destrand' option in unite(). This means CG (+strand) and GC (- strand) counts could be combined to represent as CG counts.
ᐧ

Regards,
Kalyan
